summary.name: Blueprint Drafting Animation
summary.visualIdentity: Flat blueprint-blue field (#1B3ED2) with white grid lines, clean dimension lines, dashed hidden edges, and fine 45-degree hatching in closed sections. Geometry is measured from one spec object, with real dimension labels in a monospaced technical face. The source assigns #1B3ED2 to the BLUEPRINT stage; the cream PAPER stage in the poster is not the background.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: measured part views and dimensioned object walkthroughs where precise geometry and readable labels matter. Inferred: technical explainers and product or engineering content, including interactive HTML where dimensions must stay exact. Audience, duration, and aspect ratio are unspecified beyond optional examples such as a 3-second preview.
summary.limitations: Dense hatching can alias, so pattern spacing must be checked at 1080p. The white-on-blue check (7.876) covers only two opaque colors and does not verify text over transparency, textures, or video. Material colors are not covered. Simulated appearance is not validated physics. No motion references are selected. Rough.js is rejected because it would reduce precision.
summary.palette: Background #1B3ED2 is the opaque scene field and must never be cream. Foreground #FFFFFF carries grid, outlines, dimensions, hatching, and labels. Only these two base colors are authored, with no gradient enabled. The suggested pair meets the 4.5 normal-text target. Task-supplied exact colors override these suggestions; chroma.js may validate and normalize only, without adding hues or darkening.
summary.motionAndInteraction: One paused GSAP timeline registered as window.__timelines[id] drives all motion from composition time. Sequence: grid fades in, outlines draw with DrawSVGPlugin, hidden edges draw with dashing applied by a mask, the hatch clip rect wipes in, and dimension shafts draw from both ends toward arrows. Arrowheads switch on when each shaft completes, and labels appear after their dimension and both heads finish. Verify forward, backward, and direct seeks at head-switch times. Interactive behavior is unspecified.
summary.audio: Not specified in the source. The audio direction is an open suggestion: background music, voiceover, sung vocals, sound effects, ambience, or silence may each suit the topic, audience, and narrative. No genre, tempo, instrument, voice, or mandatory layer is assigned. Any audio must be authorized, and speech must stay intelligible, unclipped, and synchronized with picture.
summary.assetRequirements: Measured geometry comes from one spec object so labels are computed from real dimensions. Fonts and assets must load before rendering. Labels use HTML/CSS or SVG text with data-reveal-after="dim-N", and arrowheads use data-arrowhead-for="dim-N". Stroke widths are 2.5px for outlines, 1.5px with dasharray 8 6 for hidden edges, and 1px for hatching. No external assets are specified, and any missing assets must be reported.
summary.combinations: Suggested secondary style: style-109 for precise contour reveals. Keep Blueprint Drafting Animation dominant and preserve its background and foreground roles. Do not import style-109's palette, and keep one geometry, typography, and material system. Avoid competing full-scene treatments or unrelated decorative motion. This is authored compatibility guidance, not a prior combination review.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default pipeline, using data-composition-id, data-width and data-height, class="clip" timing, window.__timelines, check, snapshot, and render. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation blocks a required output, and the reason must be recorded. SVG and HTML/CSS render visuals, GSAP with DrawSVGPlugin drives motion, and chroma.js is optional. Verify decoded frames, legibility, hatch aliasing, and audio sync before delivery.
